wilderness.biome.plain.desc.0: {biome} spreads out beneath your feet, and patches of Spirit Herbs roll with the terrain.
wilderness.biome.plain.desc.1: The spirit qi in {biome} is mild and even, a rare comfortable stretch for travel.
wilderness.biome.plain.desc.2: The wind sweeps through {biome}, pressing ripples into the grass.
wilderness.biome.plain.name: Spirit Field Plains
wilderness.biome.snow.desc.0: The year-round snow of {biome} reflects the sunlight until it stings, and the wind carries ice shards.
wilderness.biome.snow.desc.1: The snow of {biome} is so smooth it seems endless; only the trail of footprints you left marks it.
wilderness.biome.snow.desc.2: Chill seeps up from beneath {biome}, and the spirit qi freezes brittle.
wilderness.biome.snow.name: Frost Snowfield
wilderness.biome.volcano.desc.0: Dark red light glows through the cracks of {biome}, and the air warps with heat.
wilderness.biome.volcano.desc.1: You walk on the cooled, cracked lava crust of {biome}, and every step crunches loudly.
wilderness.biome.volcano.desc.2: The spirit qi of {biome} burns hot, and every breath tastes of sulfur.
wilderness.biome.volcano.name: Crimson Flame Volcano
